positions.title: Service Delivery Coordinator
positions.description:
Coordinated all parts of post-sale delivery of services, including:
- Initial and sustained outreach to customers regarding readiness for services
- Arranging and driving meetings between customers, Solutions Architects, and account teams to determine customer needs and develop plans for delivery
- Collected and tracking hours for Solutions Architect work time, project burndown, pro-bono efforts, ect
- Developed Statements of Work for projects outside of our standard offerings, or when required by customer
